_comment: MCP Gateway configuration — infrastructure only. Not in v1 extension request path. Activate with docker-compose.mcp.yml.

n8n._role: First-class MCP server and workflow orchestrator. Handles CI triggers, doc generation, test reporting.

git._role: Repository operations: log, diff, blame, branch management.

github._role: GitHub API: PRs, issues, releases, Actions, repo metadata.

filesystem._role: Safe filesystem read/write within the project workspace.

postgres._role: Future: session analytics, cost tracking, usage history (v2+).

docker._role: Container management for MCP stack and integration test environments.

browser._role: Browser automation: VS Code Marketplace verification, documentation scraping.

memory._role: Persistent AI agent memory: project state, decisions, completed tasks across sessions.

gateway._note: Claude Code / Copilot reads this file for MCP tool discovery. n8n orchestrates workflow automation — not business logic.

n8nWorkflows.docGeneration: Generate API docs after feature completion
n8nWorkflows.testReporting: Post test coverage reports to PR comments
n8nWorkflows.changelogUpdate: Auto-update CHANGELOG.md on merge to main
